A detector of radioactivity in a laboratory indicates an average of 16 counts / min when no
radioactive samples are present. A radioactive sample of half-life 1.5 days is placed close to
the detector, which indicates a count rate of 208 counts / min.
Calculate the count rate that is indicated 6 days later.

content.html: The waste from nuclear power stations includes the isotopes technetium-99, tin-126 and selenium-79. These isotopes are radioactive with half-lives of many thousands of years. State three economic and environmental consequences of producing this waste.
